findings.title: Take the original loadout snapshot before any catalogue actions
findings.reason: Per-slot initial IDs are captured after earlier slot mutations. A cross-slot mutation can become the later baseline and pass final restoration.
findings.fix: Snapshot all five persisted IDs once at entry; assert UI matches each original ID, restore from that immutable snapshot, and compare all five after the loop.

findings.title: Positive SVG width does not establish a visible schematic
findings.reason: The glyph assertion accepts hidden, zero-opacity, offscreen, zero-height or clipped SVGs. Text checks do not cover the glyph.
findings.fix: Scroll the glyph into view and check positive width/height, computed visibility/ancestor opacity, viewport and actual overflow clipping bounds; retain raw evidence.

findings.title: Narrow Enter follows an already completed touch equip
findings.reason: Tap equips first and waits for selected. Enter then exercises idempotent activation and keyboard focus, not a keyboard-triggered transition to a new part. Touch dispatch comes from desktop Chromium emulation, not a physical device.
findings.fix: Label evidence precisely; keep desktop Enter equip/rebuild assertion. A separate keyboard activation on an unselected narrow control is needed only to claim that specific transition.

limits: readableText establishes nonempty DOM text and bounded layout/visibility; it does not establish visual contrast or absence of unrelated overlapping overlays.
The catalogue checks headings, descriptions, benefits, tradeoffs and equip labels; per-part comparison disclosure is not in its selector list. Avoid claiming it validates all twenty comparisons.
All 20 parts are traversed across desktop/mobile/landscape emulated viewports, with live DOM input and persisted IDs. This is not physical-device acceptance or performance evidence.
preservedGoodGates: Existing native motion samples and reduced-motion checks retained unchanged.
display:contents remains excluded only from clipping bounds; hidden ancestry is still rejected.
Full text remains checked for own overflow and containing card/ancestor clipping.
The overall receipt and motion sampling explicitly disclaim performance evidence.
